an4.113:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave bhadrā assājāniyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an4.113:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco bhadro assājāniyo patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati
an4.113:1.4: kinnu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati kimassāhaṃ paṭikaromīti
an4.113:1.5: evarūpopi bhikkhave idhekacco bhadro assājāniyo hoti
an4.113:1.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo bhadro assājāniyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.

an4.113:5.1: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārome bhadrā purisājāniyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ

an4.113:5.7: pahitatto kāyena ceva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca ativijjha passati
